title: Touhou Hisouten ~ Scarlet Weather Rhapsody - Lunatic Eyes ~ Invisible Full Moon (Mega Man X3 Style)
description:
The "TH_10_5_Reisen_X3_original.txt" file is the original version with the master volume changed to reproduce "Mega Man X3 Style" as much as possible, and "TH_10_5_Reisen_X3.txt" will be the version that can be used for SMW hack. = Don't bother about "TH_10_5_Reisen_X3_original.txt".

There is a limit to the pitch that the "13 Volt Catfish_2b.brr" sample can express, so "2b_oc2.brr" (the version with octave increased by 1) was used only for the necessary parts.
